cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(dimina_wamr C)
set(WAMR_ROOT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/upstream")
if(ANDROID)
    set(WAMR_BUILD_PLATFORM "android")
elseif(APPLE)
    set(WAMR_BUILD_PLATFORM "darwin")
else()
    set(WAMR_BUILD_PLATFORM "linux")
endif()
set(WAMR_BUILD_INTERP 1)
set(WAMR_BUILD_FAST_INTERP 1)
set(WAMR_BUILD_AOT 0)
set(WAMR_BUILD_JIT 0)
set(WAMR_BUILD_FAST_JIT 0)
set(WAMR_BUILD_LIBC_BUILTIN 0)
set(WAMR_BUILD_LIBC_WASI 0)
set(WAMR_BUILD_BULK_MEMORY 1)
set(WAMR_BUILD_REF_TYPES 1)
set(WAMR_BUILD_SIMD 0)
set(WAMR_DISABLE_HW_BOUND_CHECK 1)
include("${WAMR_ROOT_DIR}/build-scripts/runtime_lib.cmake")
add_library(dimina_wamr STATIC ${WAMR_RUNTIME_LIB_SOURCE})
set_target_properties(dimina_wamr PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(dimina_wamr PUBLIC "${WAMR_ROOT_DIR}/core/iwasm/include")
target_sources(dimina_wamr PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../native/wasm/wamr_helpers.c")

if(NOT APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(dimina_wamr PUBLIC m)
endif()
